headline: Passage Rages as Berm and Nevish Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the early morning edition the fighting has quickened along three lines while a fourth has fallen silent. Callahan's Passage leads the wires with five changes in two hours and thirteen in six, twenty-five on the day, standing at nine Warden-held posts with one unheld about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage to the hour of filing, with twenty-four-hour losses near twelve thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden and both casualty rates accelerating. The Nevish Line follows with three changes in two hours and nine in six, twenty-five on the day, now six Warden to two Colonial about Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones, last heard at 08:47. Palantine Berm counts two changes in two hours and thirty-one on the day, now seven Warden-held about The Pippeli Stones, Leiri Hermanni and Windburn Landing. The Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf each show fresh movement with three and two changes in two hours respectively. Mooring County and Kuura Strand have gone quiet in the last two hours, the former last heard at 04:45 about The Wind Hills.
